title: Peter’s bold promise and the Spirit not yet given
english: If Peter had asked for that grace, perhaps — with the servant-girls and outer attendants removed — he would not have denied. For he could not yet confess the Lord [[in the Holy Spirit >> Bible:1 Corinthians 12:3]] when the Spirit had not yet been given. His bold promise became the occasion that he not only stumbled but [[denied three times >> Bible:Matthew 26:34]].
translator_notes: Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.

title: Rooster, threefold denial, Nineveh analogy
english: [[Amen I say to you, before the rooster crows, you will deny me three times >> Bible:Matthew 26:34]]. One asks whether, if he had begged that the foreknown denial be turned aside, he might not have denied — as when God, entreated by the Ninevites, did not do what he had announced through Jonah. Glory to Christ. Amen.
translator_notes: Series rem denial from PG 13 Latin.
